Portrait setting: The approach to U.A.'s main gate on a spring morning. Behind the character, a wide walkway of pale paving stones, lined with cherry trees in full bloom, runs through the open gate in a tall security wall; loose petals drift across the paving. Beyond the gate, the glass-walled main building rises in linked towers against a clear sky. No other people. No readable signs or text.
